name: Basic Needs Center

nextStep: Open the Basic Needs website and use Request Basic Needs Support, or email basicneeds@sfsu.edu.
availability: Program schedules and current food availability are unconfirmed. Office hours do not establish food distribution hours.
eligibility: Staff assess which programs fit your circumstances; eligibility is not confirmed here.

name: Housing Resources & Navigation
description: Basic Needs staff provide housing navigation, resource referrals, and assessment for emergency housing support.
nextStep: Review the housing support page and contact basicneeds@sfsu.edu to ask about an assessment.
availability: Current funding, hotel placements, and appointment availability are unknown.
eligibility: Program staff must assess eligibility. Housing or financial assistance is not guaranteed.

name: Career & Leadership Development
description: Explore jobs and internships, get resume and cover letter resources, and prepare for interviews.
nextStep: Open the career website and select Schedule an Appointment or explore Handshake.
availability: Specific appointment openings and suitability for your schedule are unknown.
eligibility: Confirm access and service requirements with the career office.

name: Counseling & Psychological Services
description: Find campus counseling services, support options, groups, and workshops.
nextStep: Review Counseling Services on the official site or call 415-338-2208 for assistance.
availability: Appointment openings and current access to particular services are unconfirmed.
eligibility: Ask CAPS about service eligibility and the appropriate support option.

name: Disability Programs & Resource Center
description: Connect with support for disability access in academics, campus events, and employment.
nextStep: Visit the Students section of the DPRC site or email dprc@sfsu.edu about getting connected.
availability: Contact DPRC to confirm specialist meeting times and availability.
eligibility: DPRC determines accommodations and requirements; this app cannot determine eligibility.

name: Tutoring & Academic Support Center
description: Free peer tutoring and academic support for SF State students, with campus and online options.
nextStep: Visit the tutoring site and select Make a One-Time Appointment or contact tutoring@sfsu.edu.
availability: Subject-specific openings are unknown. The page lists differing virtual schedules; confirm your service and time with TASC.
eligibility: Ask TASC to confirm support for your course and current enrollment.

name: Office of Student Financial Aid
description: Get help navigating financial aid applications, awards, scholarships, and the aid process.
nextStep: Use Contact Us on the financial aid website to ask about your next step.
availability: Appointment availability and the status of individual awards are unknown.
eligibility: The financial aid office determines eligibility and award conditions. Funding is not guaranteed.

name: Undergraduate Advising Center
description: Get guidance on degree planning, choosing classes, exploring majors, and academic success strategies.
nextStep: Use Schedule an Appointment on the advising website, or call 415-338-2101 for booking help.
availability: Appointment openings are unknown. Drop-in access depends on staff availability and advising team.
eligibility: This center serves undergraduate advising needs; confirm the correct team for your situation.
